answer_1.quote: We perform extensive experiments on two benchmark datasets: DailyDialog and OpenSubtitles ... The success of neural models has greatly advanced the research of dialog generation.

answer_2.quote: We first used automatic metrics to evaluate our method: 1) Distinct (Dist) ..., 2) Entropy (Ent) ..., 3) Low-Frequency Token Ratio (LF) ..., 4) BLEU ...

answer_4.quote: Pairwise manual evaluations are conducted to further validate our method. Three individual annotators were employed to rank each response pair from three aspects: 1) Fluency (Flu.), 2) Coherency (Coh.), 3) Informativeness (Info.). We also asked the annotator to choose an overall preferred response (Pref.).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to rank each response pair on fluency, coherency, informativeness, and overall preference.
